newsitem.title: USA: US mortgage-backeds well-bought, spreads narrow.
newsitem.headline: US mortgage-backeds well-bought, spreads narrow.

text.p: Broadly based buying supported U.S. mortgage-backed securities prices on Wednesday, traders said.
Spreads over Treasuries narrowed one to two basis points, as mortgages slipped 1/32 to 3/32 overall while comparable Treasuries fell 4/32 to 6/32, they said.
"There was good buying today, particularly in higher coupons like 8.0s and 8.5s," one trader said. "It was a pretty busy day.
In key coupons, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent paper was off 2/32 at 100-25/32, yielding 110 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac paper was off 2/32 as well, at 100-19/32 and 100-24/32, respectively.
The 10-year Treasury note was down 6/32 at 99-19/32 to yield 6.31 percent.
Treasuries prices initially rose after the benign January Consumer Price Index report, but they slid lower amid stock market weakness late in the day, analysts said.
Both headline and core CPI rose 0.1 percent last month.
